s.g: A digestive fluid containing fatty droplets, found in the small intestine.

chyle.f: Alternative form of chile (pronunciation spelling of "child")

s.g: (biology) A microscopic globule of lipoprotein, found in blood and lymph, that is associated with the digestion of fats.
An accumulation of chyle in the pleural cavity.
The thick semifluid mass of partly digested food that is passed from the stomach to the duodenum.
(biochemistry) An endopeptidase enzyme that cleaves peptides at the carboxyl side of tyrosine, tryptophan, and phenylalanine amino acids.
Any of several perfumes having a citrus top note and woody base notes.
Any of a family of fragrances built on a base consisting of bergamot, oakmoss and labdanum.
(US, television) A set of graphics or words at the bottom of a television screen, sometimes unrelated to the current viewing content.
(US, television, transitive) To display (material) on screen by this technology.

chyron.f: Alternative spelling of ciron (“the itch-mite (Sarcoptes scabiei), which infects the skin”).

s.g: Any fungus of the phylum Chytridiomycota.
An infectious disease of amphibians caused by Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis (amphibian chytrid fungus) or (chiefly in salamanders and newts) by Batrachochytrium salamandrivorans.
